name: Payments mobile transaction recovery
failure_pattern: Desktop transaction detail/recovery surface is hidden on 320/390.
acceptance: The transaction detail/recovery task remains reachable and completable through an equivalent mobile surface; no task-critical action is removed.

name: SaaS mobile editable detail
failure_pattern: Desktop editable detail pane disappears on 320/390.
acceptance: Selection, detail/edit, validation, save/cancel, recovery, and return context remain available through an equivalent mobile composition.

name: Analytics exhaustive enabled-control closure
failure_pattern: Visible navigation, period, overflow, or filter controls render enabled without observable behavior.
acceptance: Every enabled visible control has observable behavior; dead-control count is zero and no enabled control is omitted from evidence.
